correctness.rationale: A centered two-time cross-particle squared-position covariance factors exactly into 4D² times the stationary common renewal-age covariance. A cyclic k-stage phase-and-age Markov generator with stationary uniform stage weights and conditional Gamma ages gives an exact finite matrix system and the four explicit positive low-shape formulas. For all k≥5 the slow conjugate phase eigenvalues have nonzero summed residue −1/(ζ−1)² and decay strictly slower than other modes, implying infinitely many strict sign reversals. Numerical generator comparisons and independently sampled stationary cycles corroborate finite cases; the spectral proof establishes the infinite assertion.

value.rationale: Cross-particle energy covariance at nonzero lag is a natural physical temporal observable for a collectively resetting Brownian gas, distinct from its equal-time energy correlation. Identifying the first clock regularity (k=5) that causes infinitely many anti-correlated lag intervals, while all less regular Erlang clocks stay positive, is a sharp structural boundary with a proof through the dominant complex phase mode. This does not assert a large experimental effect at long lag.
